title: Google Cloud Infrastructure Offerings and APIs

header.html: 4. Modernize infrastructure and applications with Google Cloud (about 18%)

4.2 Describe the functionality, business use cases and business value of Google Cloud's infrastructure offerings: Compute Engine; modern application development; GKE; serverless products (Cloud Run, Cloud Run functions); products supported on multicloud and hybrid environments (AlloyDB Omni, BigQuery Omni, GKE Enterprise, Cloud SQL, Looker). 4.3 Describe the business value of application programming interfaces (APIs), including Apigee API Management
the official Google Cloud Digital Leader exam guide

html:
1Compute Engine

Compute Engine is IaaS: virtual machines on Google's infrastructure.

Point Fact
Business value Full control of the operating system and software; many machine sizes; pay for use; good for lift and shift and specialized or legacy applications
Cost options Spot VMs for fault-tolerant work; committed use discounts for steady use
Scale Autoscaling and load balancing across instances

2Modern application development

Practice Business value
Flexible architectures such as microservices Change and scale parts of an app independently
Managed services Faster deployment; less operations work
Cost optimization Pay for what runs; scale down when idle
Scalability and resilience Handle demand spikes and survive failures
Operational efficiency Teams ship features instead of maintaining servers

3Containers and serverless

Product What it is Business value
Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE) Managed Kubernetes to deploy and manage containers at scale Portability, automated scaling and repair, control over containerized apps
Cloud Run Serverless platform for containers that scales to zero Fast deployment, no cluster to manage, pay per use
Cloud Run functions Serverless functions that run code in response to events (earlier named Cloud Functions) Small event-driven tasks with no servers
Exam tip

. Container control at scale → GKE. Containers without managing a cluster → Cloud Run. Event-driven snippets of code → Cloud Run functions.

4Hybrid and multicloud products

Product What it does
GKE Enterprise Run and manage GKE and Kubernetes clusters across Google Cloud, other clouds and on-premises with one management view
AlloyDB Omni AlloyDB (PostgreSQL-compatible) that runs in your own data center or another cloud
BigQuery Omni Analyze data stored in other clouds with BigQuery, without moving it
Cloud SQL Managed databases that also support hybrid migration paths
Looker Business intelligence that connects to data in many clouds
Exam tip

. The "Omni" products take Google Cloud technology to where the data already is. They support multicloud and hybrid strategies.

5APIs and Apigee

An application programming interface (API) is a defined way for software to talk to other software.

Idea Fact
New opportunities Expose and monetize public APIs: partners and developers build on your services; new revenue streams and ecosystems
Reuse and speed Teams reuse the same APIs instead of rebuilding features
Apigee API Management Design, secure, publish, monitor and monetize APIs: security, traffic control, analytics and a developer portal
Exam tip

. Apigee = manage and secure APIs and turn them into products. Do not mix it up with Compute Engine or GKE.

6Exam Q&A

6.1 Practice questions (choose the best answer)

S1A company needs full control of the operating system for a specialized legacy application in the cloud. Which product fits?

  • ACloud Run, which is serverless for containers on demand
  • BCloud Run functions, which run small functions
  • CCompute Engine, which provides virtual machines
  • DLooker, which builds business dashboards
Show the answer

Answer: C. Compute Engine provides virtual machines with full control of the operating system.

S2A team wants to run containers at scale with portability and control over the cluster. Which product fits best?

  • AGoogle Kubernetes Engine, a managed Kubernetes service
  • BCloud Storage, an object store for files
  • CPub/Sub, a messaging service for events
  • DSpanner, a global relational database
Show the answer

Answer: A. GKE is the managed Kubernetes service for deploying and managing containers at scale.

S3A team wants to deploy a containerized web app quickly, with no cluster to manage and a bill that falls to zero when idle. Which product fits?

  • ACloud Run, a serverless platform for containers
  • BCompute Engine, with always-on virtual machines
  • CBigQuery, a serverless data warehouse
  • DCloud SQL, a managed relational database
Show the answer

Answer: A. Cloud Run runs containers without cluster management and scales to zero.

S4A company runs Kubernetes clusters in Google Cloud, another cloud and its own data center and wants one place to manage them. Which product fits?

  • ACloud Storage with Autoclass
  • BCloud Run functions
  • CGKE Enterprise
  • DDataflow
Show the answer

Answer: C. GKE Enterprise manages Kubernetes clusters across clouds and on-premises with one view.

S5An analyst wants to use BigQuery to analyze data that stays in another cloud. Which product fits?

  • AAlloyDB Omni for PostgreSQL workloads on premises
  • BBigQuery Omni for multicloud analytics
  • CApigee for API management
  • DCloud SQL for relational applications
Show the answer

Answer: B. BigQuery Omni lets BigQuery analyze data stored in other clouds without moving it.

S6A company wants to publish its services as APIs for partners, secure them and track their use. Which product fits?

  • AGKE Enterprise
  • BSpot VMs
  • CDataflow
  • DApigee API Management
Show the answer

Answer: D. Apigee is the API management product to publish, secure, monitor and monetize APIs.

6.2 Recall questions

R1Which product provides virtual machines?

Show the answer

Compute Engine.

R2What is GKE?

Show the answer

Managed Kubernetes for containers.

R3Which product runs containers serverlessly?

Show the answer

Cloud Run.

R4What do Cloud Run functions run?

Show the answer

Small pieces of code in response to events.

R5What does BigQuery Omni do?

Show the answer

Analyzes data in other clouds without moving it.

R6What does Apigee manage?

Show the answer

APIs: design, security, publishing and monetization.

7Quick Reference Card

Topic Key fact
Compute Compute Engine (VMs, most control), GKE (containers), Cloud Run (serverless containers), Cloud Run functions (events)
Hybrid and multicloud GKE Enterprise, AlloyDB Omni, BigQuery Omni, Cloud SQL, Looker
APIs new business opportunities; Apigee to manage, secure and monetize
